fit.instructions: state.site_profile describes what the website sells, its core expertise, its adjacent topics and what counts as off-topic. state.page is one page of that site: url, title, h1, an opening excerpt and the top search queries it receives. Classify how the main topic of the page relates to the site's expertise, following the definitions in state.site_profile. Judge the topic only, not the writing quality.

criteria.service_offer: A page that sells or describes the site's own services, training, pricing, quote or contact path.
criteria.core_topic: An article whose main topic is inside the core expertise listed in the site profile.
criteria.adjacent_topic: An article on a neighbouring topic that the site profile lists as adjacent.
criteria.off_topic: An article whose main topic the site profile lists as off-topic, or that is outside both the core and the adjacent topics.
criteria.company_info: About, team, careers, policy, legal, customer story, event or other company information page.
